body:
I chipped my tooth a few days ago and for some reason the doctor's felt that they should prescribe me Vicodin for the 'pain' which I told them there was none of.
Anyways, I figured if I was going to get Vicodin I was going to use it. It's been about twenty minutes now since I orally ingested the pills with a few sips of water. It's been about 4 hours since my last meal (a TV dinner), 48 hours since my last cigarette, and 48 hours since my last contact with marijuana. So far, all I've experienced is some mild itchiness.
I fear that this experimentation with Vicodin will once again prove to be somewhat lackluster. I drank about 2 tablespoons of liquid Vicodin and took 3 pills of Percocet last summer and all they did was make me fall asleep after feeling really itchy. I am bummed.
